Definition: from a compound of G3956 and G4443; every-tribal, i.e. heterogeneous (G5561 being implied); Pamphylia, a region of Asia Minor:--Pamphylia.
BiblicalUsage: Pamphylia is the coastal region of Asia Minor where Paul's first missionary journey lands at Perga. Paul and Barnabas pass through it on their way back to Antioch, and John Mark departs from it — the parting that later divides Paul and Barnabas.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Pamphylia is where mission gets real: a landing, a long road home, and a parting over a young man who left, and God uses all of it.
